question: Top 5 customers by number of orders
sql:
SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName
ORDER BY OrderCount DESC
LIMIT 5

ORDER BY

LIMIT 200

question: Average order value by country
sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS OrderMonth,
    c.Country,
    SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM 
    "Orders" o
JOIN 
    "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
JOIN 
    "Customers" c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    OrderMonth, c.Country
ORDER BY 
    OrderMonth, AverageOrderValue DESC
LIMIT 200
